{{Top|leg}}
The '''Zynt'aia Spice Guardians''' were [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] who operated during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
During [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the Zynt'aia Spice Guardians primarily operated out of the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]], keeping a tight grip over the [[Declorian Territory]].
